papers.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
papers.abstract: Real-time interactive video generation model supporting voice control of digital characters with infinite-length video generation at up to 42 FPS on consumer GPUs, supporting custom image uploads.

papers.title: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Diagnostic suite revealing 55% of video understanding benchmarks are solvable without visual input, exposing capability gaps and providing foundation for rigorous video-LLM evaluation.

papers.title: Why Can't I Open My Drawer? Mitigating Object-Driven Shortcuts in Zero-Shot Compositional Action Recognition
papers.abstract: Addresses object-driven shortcuts in zero-shot compositional action recognition through co-occurrence prior regularization and temporal order regularization to improve generalization.

papers.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: Capability-driven benchmark evaluating proactive agents in dynamic real-world settings across five foundational model capabilities using live Docker containers and closed-loop evaluation.

papers.title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Leverages pre-trained video diffusion priors for event-based video reconstruction with temporal stability improvements, achieving state-of-the-art results across reconstruction and interpolation tasks.

papers.title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
papers.abstract: Two-stage framework combining geometry-aware pretraining with fine-tuning for panoramic image generation, featuring 1M paired samples and parallel depth generation for improved geometric consistency.

papers.title: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
papers.abstract: Fine-tuned GPT-2 model generating small molecules conditioned on disease ontology and target protein sequences, achieving superior binding affinity and molecular diversity compared to baselines.

papers.title: CineMobile: On-Device Image-to-Video Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Efficient image-to-video generation on mobile devices through distillation-guided pruning and hybrid quantization, achieving 40x speedup while maintaining visual quality for cinematic effects.

papers.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
papers.abstract: Comparative study of softmax and recurrent linear-attention architectures, analyzing expressivity, memory decay, and training throughput across different model scales and sequence lengths.

papers.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Plug-and-play memory agent running alongside action agents, updating structured memory banks and selectively injecting reminders to prevent behavioral state decay in long-horizon tasks.

cc_updates.body: Auto mode is now available without CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE opt-in on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry; disable via disableAutoMode in settings. Fixed the terminal freezing and keystrokes lagging while streaming responses containing very long lists, tables, paragraphs, or code blocks. Fixed remote managed settings from a non-interactive run being permanently recorded as consented without ever showing the security consent dialog. Fixed spurious prompt-injection warnings triggered by benign system-generated conversation updates. Fixed the auto-updater overwriting a custom launcher script or symlink at ~/.local/bin/claude on every release; /doctor now reports an externally managed launcher.

Added directory path suggestions to /cd, matching /add-dir behavior. Added a /doctor check that proposes trimming checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content Claude could derive from the codebase. /commit-push-pr now auto-allows git push to the repo's configured push remote in addition to origin. Gateway: /login now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints. EnterWorktree now asks for confirmation before entering a git worktree outside the project's .claude/worktrees/ directory.

Added an auto mode rule that blocks tampering with session transcript files. Fixed --json-schema silently producing unstructured output when the schema was invalid, and schemas using the format keyword being rejected. Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being silently lost when the turn ended at the --max-turns limit. Fixed Windows worktree removal deleting files outside the worktree when an NTFS junction or directory symlink existed inside it. Fixed background agents staying shown as failed or completed in the agent list after being resumed with SendMessage.
